p: kine of Bashan: Thus he calls the princes and governors, who being overwhelmed with the great abundance of God's benefits, forgot God, and therefore he calls them by the name of beasts and not of men.
Bring: They encourage those who have authority over the people to oppress them, so that they may have profit by it.
hooks: He alludes to fishers, who catch fish by hooks or thorns.
Bethel: He speaks this in contempt of those who resorted to those places, thinking that their great devotion and good intention was sufficient to have bound God to them.
liketh you: You only delight in these outward ceremonies and care for nothing else.
cleanness of teeth in all your: That is, lack of bread and meat.
months to the harvest: I stopped the rain until the fruits of the earth were destroyed with drought, and yet you would not consider to return to me by repentance.
not satisfied: They could not find enough water where they had heard that it had rained.
Egypt: As I plagued the Egyptians; Ex 9:10.
firebrand plucked out of the burning: You were almost all consumed, and a few of you were wonderfully preserved; 2Ki 14:26.
meet thy God: Turn to him by repentance.
